item_desc5081525.en:
To the west of the lands lies the Wayward Desert. Nothing grows there except in its center, where flowers and plants thrive. Amidst them all is a spiritual root with a yellow, bead-like fruit that holds a great amount of life essence. Eat it to bring the dead back to life.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in the <g>{#areaName7}</g> area.
<g>●</g>You may obtain the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> in the <g>Land of No Return</g> of the <g>{#areaName6}</g> area. Activate the <g>Mythical Beast Map</g> to find <r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>, where you may slay the <r>Mythical Beast</r> for a chance to obtain this item.
item_desc5081525.ch:
八荒之西，有一迷途荒漠，千万里一片荒芜，唯其中央处百里之域花草繁茂，生机勃勃，在那有一株灵根名曰黄中李，其果色黄形似珠蕊，蕴含无限生机，有延年益寿起死回生之功效。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName7}</g>区域内出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName6}</g>区域内的<g>不归之境</g>中获得<g>五岳真形图</g>，激活<g>五岳真形图</g>即可寻找到<r>{#battle_dungeon_name7241}</r>，击杀其中的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081535.en: There is a holy tree called the Heaven's Cassia, and it's been absorbing the powers of the sun and moon for thousands of years. However, it is not the heaven's will for such a magical plant to exist, and the tree is therefore ravaged by storms every ten thousand years. The tree remains standing, though, with only a few of its branches snapped and carried into the mortal world by the wind.
item_desc5081535.ch: 八荒之中有一株神树，名曰天桂，千万载吸收太阴月华之力，诞生灵智。此等神物天所不容，每过万年便受罡风摧残，然天桂屹立不倒，只是有少许枝干被吹断，随着罡风飘散世间。

item_desc5081545.en: The flower resembles a rooster's crown, while its leaves resemble a phoenix's tail. It's a rare plant considered quite precious.
item_desc5081545.ch: 花如鸡冠叶如凤尾，亦属八荒灵植珍品。

item_desc5081555.en: It's shaped like a lotus leaf, with a two-meter long stem, black, shiny, and great for detoxing.
item_desc5081555.ch: 形似莲叶，茎长二尺，又黑又亮，有驱毒之功效。

item_desc5081565.en: Grown in the lotus pond on Tian Yuan Mountain, this plant has a long stem as thick as a human's arm. The flowers come in four colors: pink, red, blue and white, each with its own unique effects.
item_desc5081565.ch: 生长在天元山莲花池，叶茎粗如人臂，长约丈许，花开四色，粉红青白，各有奇效。

item_desc5081575.en: A black herb shaped like a ganoderma. On it is a small human shaped like a baby. The liquid in its root is highly poisonous, making it deadly even to immortals.
item_desc5081575.ch: 一棵形如灵芝的黑草，乌光四射，芝上有个如同婴儿般的小人，根内汁液含剧毒，据传即便是仙人也难以承受。

item_desc5081585.en: It's got a blue stalk, flaming red leaves, and a body clear like crystal. On the tips of the leaves are tiny red beans, which are rumored to be able to bring the dead back to life. This herb is rarely spotted unless by those with a high cultivation level.
item_desc5081585.ch: 碧梗朱叶，其红如火，遍体明如晶玉，一叶二岐，岐尖结红豆朱实，据传食之有起死回生之效，此草常人难见，无有仙缘不可得。

item_desc5081595.en: It does not grow unless nurtured by the qi of the mountains and rivers, and has no set schedule in bearing fruit. It's a highly effective herb that would totally change the life of a mortal if eaten. If a cultivator eats it, they gain a hundred years of experience.
item_desc5081595.ch: 非山川灵气不得生长，结实无定期，此芝具非凡功效，常人食之脱胎换骨，易筋洗髓，修行之人食之亦可增长百年修为。

item_desc5081605.en: Born next to the Holy Spring, this plant has absorbed the clear aura of the heavens and can be used for detoxing.
item_desc5081605.ch: 生长于灵泉旁，吸纳天地清气，品最高洁，专破恶岚毒瘴。

item_desc5081615.en:
A rare plant that absorbed the golden essence of the universe from the west. It's as tough as steel and has the quality of gold, not needing soil to grow.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName8}</g> area.
item_desc5081615.ch:
此草是八荒奇珍，吸纳西方太乙金精，身坚如铁，元金赋质，见土不生。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName8}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081625.en:
Also known as the flower of the shared fragrance, this plant smells extremely good and refreshing. It can be used to reverse aging.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName8}</g> area.
item_desc5081625.ch:
颜仙草又名同芳花，香味甚奇，嗅之心神为之一爽，有返老还童驻颜益寿之功效。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName8}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081635.en:
Shaped like a large snake with a horn, it resembles a dragon with a red mane and reversed scales underneath its waist. With each breath it forms the silhouette of cities, which is what many call a "mirage". The Mirage Pearl lies at its core.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName8}</g> area.
item_desc5081635.ch:
蜃，其状亦似蛇而大，有角如龙状，红鬣，腰以下鳞尽逆，能吁气成楼台城郭之状，将雨卽见，名蜃楼，亦曰海市，其内丹即是蜃气珠。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName8}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081645.en:
It contains powerful Fire Spirit powers and is considered very helpful for cultivators. 
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName8}</g> area.
item_desc5081645.ch:
蕴含非常强大的火灵真力，能够助长修仙者的实力。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName8}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081655.en:
Black all over, it grows only deep underground. Its flames devour all.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName8}</g> area.
item_desc5081655.ch:
通体乌黑，只生长在地心深处，地火之炎无物不焚。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName8}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081665.en:
It only grows where the ice-cold meets the flaming hot. It functions as a mediator between yin and yang, but is very rare as not even one is grown in one thousand years.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName8}</g> area.
item_desc5081665.ch:
只生长在冰炎交汇之地，蕴有寒冰烈火之能，有调和阴阳之功效。即便千年都难以生长一株，世所罕见。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName8}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081675.en:
There's a vast ocean to the east of the lands. On the ocean floor is a spiritual algae that gleams in a mystic blue and contains the essence of the anemones and waters. 
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName8}</g> area.
item_desc5081675.ch:
八荒之东，有一海域，广袤无边。海底深处有一灵藻，散发幽幽蓝光，蕴含葵水之精。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName8}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081685.en:
A rare item formed by five original elements: gold, water, wood, fire and earth, each of them interlocking, interacting and prevailing over each other. Even after ten thousand years, the elements have not yet become one. 
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName8}</g> area.
item_desc5081685.ch:
世间罕有的神物，由金，水，木，火，土，五道本源，环扣相接，生克协合，循环反复，生生不息，即便数万年难成其一。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName8}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081695.en: A gossamer bamboo leaf that holds a great amount of energy.
item_desc5081695.ch: 一种晶莹剔透的翠绿竹叶，具有庞大的灵力。

item_desc5081705.en: Eat this to forget all troubling memories.
item_desc5081705.ch: 服食可忘前尘往事，故而无忧。

item_desc5081715.en: An exotic plant from the south. Can be used to absorb gold and metal substances.
item_desc5081715.ch: 八荒之南，所产异植，可吸纳金铁之物。

item_desc5081725.en: The condensed essence of divine gold from the west. Holds tremendous power.
item_desc5081725.ch: 西方太乙庚金精粹凝结而成，其中所蕴含的能量极为庞大。

item_desc5081735.en:
A precious Heaven and Earth Treasure. Can erode away blood, flesh and souls. Extremely mortifying.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in the <g>{#areaName9}</g> area.
item_desc5081735.ch:
八荒中珍贵的天材地宝之一，可消磨血肉精骨，腐蚀元神魂魄，吞解真灵念识，煞是可怖。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName9}</g>区域内出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081745.en:
Blue and green. Often found under the sea.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in the <g>{#areaName9}</g> area.
item_desc5081745.ch:
青蓝相间，多产于海底。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName9}</g>区域内出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081755.en:
Purple all over and hollow. Holds the powers of thunder.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in the <g>{#areaName9}</g> area.
item_desc5081755.ch:
通体紫色内里空心，蕴含浩大雷霆真力。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName9}</g>区域内出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081765.en:
A phoenix feather that brings good luck to all who hold it.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in the <g>{#areaName9}</g> area.
item_desc5081765.ch:
凤凰之羽，据传持有他的人会福运连连。
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName9}</g>区域内出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081775.en: A mystic herb that's absorbed dragon's powers for a thousand years. Cultivators can use this to enhance their abilities.
item_desc5081775.ch: 吸收龙之力后，经数千年衍变成长而成的神草，可帮助修仙者提升实力。

item_desc5081785.en: A rare treasure of ten thousand years, holding the power of principles. Attracts all energy from the surroundings.
item_desc5081785.ch: 经万年演化而来的奇珍，具有极强的法则之力。会吸引周围的灵力凝聚在其上方。

item_desc5081795.en: Evolved constellation wood from hundreds of years ago. An astronomy chart is drawn on it. Decipher it to understand the secrets of the stars.
item_desc5081795.ch: 星纹木经数百年演变而成，上绘周天星斗之图，若能解析便可明了星辰奥秘。

item_desc5081805.en: A crimson pellet that contains bright flames.
item_desc5081805.ch: 一种赤红颗粒，蕴含离火之炎。

item_desc5081815.en: A bright, crimson crystal that can be blinding if stared at for too long.
item_desc5081815.ch: 一种赤红晶体，散发耀眼光芒，若久视会使人目盲。

item_desc5081825.en: "Shine bright, o moon and sun, on the myriad worlds." The Luminous Leaf was once a dead leaf that absorbed the essence from the sun and moon for thousands of years. The instant it's done, the heavens and lands shattered and beams of bright light enveloped the world.
item_desc5081825.ch: 日月为明光照大千！明光神叶未出世之时，形如枯叶，待吸收日月精华万载，天地崩裂，霎时昊光万丈，通耀世间，昭示神叶出世。

item_desc5081835.en: This teardrop-shaped, jade-colored item is extremely rare. While no one can tell for sure its origin, it's rumored that it fell into the mortal world from the nine heavens and thus gained its name "the Immortal's Tear".
item_desc5081835.ch: 形如泪滴，碧绿萤翠，产地不明世间少有，据传是从九天之上堕入凡尘，故名仙泪。

item_desc5081845.en: After absorbing the essence of the blood of living beings for years, it gradually turned a red color and gained bloody streaks. The more streaks there are, the better the quality.
item_desc5081845.ch: 常年累月吸收生灵血液中的精华，其色渐赤并生血痕，血痕越多品质越好。

item_desc5081855.en:
An extremely rare, freezing cold item. Considered a precious treasure.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName10}</g> area.
item_desc5081855.ch:
八荒中极为罕见的极寒之物，是十分珍贵的天财地宝。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName10}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081865.en: A divine item said to have been left behind by an immortal in the human world. Can be used to twist time and space, yet no one has been able to harness its powers for thousands of years. Perhaps it's waiting for its destined master?<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName10}</g> area.
item_desc5081865.ch:
据传是仙神遗落凡尘的神物，具有扭转时空的威能。然数千年来，几易人手却无人可发挥其功效，或许神物也在等天命之主，待时以助。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName10}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

An item that went through ten thousand years of evolution, absorbing the powers of the moon and the constellations.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName10}</g> area.
item_desc5081875.ch:
吸收了星辰与皓月之力，经万年演化后所成之物。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName10}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName10}</g> area.

<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName10}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName10}</g> area.
item_desc5081895.ch:
八荒中极为珍贵的天财地宝，常有高纯度的灵液溢出而凝结在其表面上。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName10}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName10}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

An eerie black flame emitting a deathly aura.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName10}</g> area.

通体幽黑的异火，散发出阵阵死气。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName10}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

A powerful item holding the powers of principles. Has been absorbing the power of souls for ten thousand years.
<g>●</g>May be obtained by slaying the <r>Mythical Beast</r> in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5} or {#building1001Name6} in the <g>{#areaName10}</g> area.

凝聚了天地间无数的魂力，经万年衍化而成，拥有至高无上的法则之力。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName10}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。

item_desc5081996.en:

<g>●</g>Obtain <g>Breath of Soul Formation Shards</g> from <g>Stairway to Heaven</g> in <g>{#areaName6}</g>, then pass the trial of the <g>Skygate Keeper</g> to combine all the shards you have into Breaths of Soul Formation.

item_desc5082066.en:
The epitome of Taoism. Decipher the mystery it contains, and you can use its power to form your Rule Fields.
<g>●</g>Collect 3 Tao Souls with matching stats to combine them. Note: Each Tao Soul must be combinable with the other 2 Tao Souls.
<g>●</g>Clear <g>Tao Realms</g> in <g>{#areaName8}</g> for a chance to obtain Tao Souls with their corresponding skills and stats.
item_desc5082066.ch:
蕴含强烈道法规则的精华宝物，修仙者领悟到其中的规则奥秘之后，可利用道法之力助自身突破悟道，并运用规则形成自己的领域。
<g>●</g>需要3个可相互融合的道魂才可悟道。（道魂的融合规则为：每个道魂都有其可融合的属性，每个道魂都必须可与其它2个道魂融合才可）。
<g>●</g>可在<g>{#areaName8}</g>内不同的<g>道界</g>中，通过道界试炼，即有概率获得对应功法或属性的道魂。

item_desc5082205.en:
According to the legend, when those of lower realms reach the threshold of the heavenly realm, its usher will give them this high-dimension will. It has no shadow or shape, and it dissipates in an instant. Only the most talented and hardworking cultivators have a chance to obtain it. Once mastered, it will allow them to peek at the law of the heavenly realm to prime the Heavenly Power within them, which resulted from the blending of Qi and Nether Air, for the casting of arts far beyond the lower realms.
<g>●</g>Obtained after withstanding Transcendent Trial of Lightning using {#item_name7000066} in <g>Reborn Late</g>.

<g>●</g>可在<g>羽化后期</g>，使用{#item_name7000066}后抵抗住登仙雷劫获得。

item_desc6031011.en: Elixirs concocted by a sect. You need to deliver them to the specified town or village.
item_desc6031011.ch: 宗门生产的丹药，需要将其运送至指定的城镇或村庄。

item_desc6051011.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Huayu Elixir.
Huayu Elixir: The most common healing Elixir. Use to recover Vitality by a small amount.
item_desc6051011.ch:
记录着化瘀丹的炼制方法。
化瘀丹：最为常见的疗伤丹药，使用后能够恢复少量的体力值。

item_desc6051021.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Blood Circulation Elixir.
Blood Circulation Elixir: A rare healing Elixir allocated only by sect elders and leaders. Use to recover Elixir by a medium amount.
item_desc6051021.ch:
记录着活血丹的炼制方法。
活血丹：比较稀有的丹药，在一般的宗门内只有长老和掌门才有资格分配少量的活血丹。使用后能够恢复一定的体力值。

item_desc6051031.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Revival Elixir.
Revival Elixir: The recipe for this Elixir originated from the beginning of time. Many years ago, its incomplete version was once again found in a set of ruins. Though incomplete, the Elixir concocted using this recipe can recover Vitality by a large amount.
item_desc6051031.ch:
记录着复生丹的炼制方法。
复生丹：据说此丹方的根源来自上古时期，多年前在一处遗迹中被发现了其中一本残篇才得以现世。即便丹方不完整，炼制出来的丹药也能够让一般的具灵强者在虚弱时恢复巅峰状态。使用后能够恢复较多的体力值。

item_desc6051041.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Blood Melting Elixir.
Blood Melting Elixir: An extremely rare healing Elixir. Only a handful of Alchemists in the world can concoct it. Use to recover Vitality by a large amount.
item_desc6051041.ch:
记录着融血丹的炼制方法。
融血丹：极其罕见的疗伤圣药，能够炼制此丹的炼丹师在这片八荒中屈指可数。此丹拥有着即温和又强大的药力。使用后能够恢复较多的体力值。

item_desc6051051.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Sacred Sun Elixir.
Sacred Sun Elixir: A healing Elixir of legend. Many skilled Alchemists have never seen it before. Its strong healing power heals Cultivators quickly. Many sects consider this Elixir their Sect Treasure. Use to recover Vitality by an enormous amount.
item_desc6051051.ch:
记录着九转圣阳丹的炼制方法。
九转圣阳丹：只存在于传说中的疗伤圣药，即便是八荒中技艺较高的炼丹师也很少有人见过其面貌。其庞大的药力可让附近的一般修真者加速伤势的恢复，被一般的宗门奉为镇宗之宝。使用后能够恢复大量的体力值。

item_desc6051061.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Energy Gathering Elixir.
Energy Gathering Elixir: The most common Energy Elixir. Use to recover Energy by a small amount.
item_desc6051061.ch:
记录着聚气丹的炼制方法。
聚气丹：最为常见的能够恢复灵力的丹药，使用后能够恢复少量的灵力值。

item_desc6051071.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Nutrition Elixir.
Nutrition Elixir: This Elixir is occasionally sold at markets. Most Cultivators acknowledge its efficiency. Use to recover Energy by a medium amount.
item_desc6051071.ch:
记录着培元丹的炼制方法。
培元丹：在坊市中偶尔会有商贩售卖此丹药，其功效受到多数修真者的认可。。使用后能够恢复一定的灵力值。

item_desc6051081.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Unity Elixir.
Unity Elixir: An effective but pricey Elixir. Only a few people in big sects can afford it. Use to recover Energy by a medium amount.
item_desc6051081.ch:
记录着玄元丹的炼制方法。
玄元丹：价格与药效齐高的丹药，只有宗门和大家族中的精英才有条件使用。使用后能够恢复一定的灵力值。

item_desc6051091.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Energy Recovery Elixir.
Energy Recovery Elixir: A must-have Elixir when fighting against strong opponents. Use to recover Energy by a large amount.
item_desc6051091.ch:
记录着复灵丹的炼制方法。
复灵丹：高手的搏杀中必不可少的丹药，其强大的药力能够让干涸的灵力迅速恢复。使用后能够恢复较多的灵力值。

item_desc6051101.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Guanglin Elixir.
Guanglin Elixir: Rumor has it, this Elixir is a life changer for Cultivators, but most people have never seen it. Use to recover Energy by a large amount.
item_desc6051101.ch:
记录着广陵丹的炼制方法。
广陵丹：坊市中有传言说，此丹药拥有脱胎换骨逆天改命之效，但大多人一生中都未谋其面。使用后能够恢复较多的灵力值。

item_desc6051111.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Souldrinking Elixir.
Souldrinking Elixir: A genius concocted this Elixir in a sacred place. Afterwards, the energy of lives was depleted. With the exhaustion of Qi, creatures died, and that place was gradually forgotten. Use to recover Energy by an enormous amount.
item_desc6051111.ch:
记录着幽冥饮魄丹的炼制方法。
幽冥饮魄丹：有一位不出世的天才在某处圣地炼制出了此丹，此地大量的生机与灵气被消耗殆尽，事后此地生灵涂炭、灵气稀薄，逐渐被世人所遗忘。使用后能够恢复大量的灵力值。

item_desc6051121.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Power Charge Elixir.
Power Charge Elixir: The most common ATK Elixir popular amongst cultivation beginners. Use to temporarily increase ATK by a small amount.
item_desc6051121.ch:
记录着蓄力丹的炼制方法。
蓄力丹：最常见的增加功力的丹药，深受低阶的修真者欢迎。使用后能暂时提升少量的攻击。

item_desc6051131.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Scarlet Sun Elixir.
Scarlet Sun Elixir: A rare Elixir that boosts your power in crucial moments. Use to temporarily increase ATK by a medium amount.
item_desc6051131.ch:
记录着赤阳丹的炼制方法。
赤阳丹：药性较强的丹药，自然也是十分珍贵的，在关键时刻能够提升你的实力帮助你渡过难关。使用后能暂时提升一定的攻击。

item_desc6051141.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Bloodthirsty Elixir.
Bloodthirsty Elixir: An Elixir concocted using Blazing Blood Flowers. Taking it will make your blood boil and become bellicose. Cultivators without a strong will can easily lose control of themselves. Use to temporarily increase ATK by a medium amount.
item_desc6051141.ch:
记录着嗜血丹的炼制方法。
嗜血丹：增加功力的丹药，服用过后全身血气翻涌，十分嗜战，意志力较差的修真者容易失去理智。使用后能暂时提升一定的攻击。

item_desc6051151.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Dragon Force Elixir.
Dragon Force Elixir: A Cultivator once took this Elixir and became strong enough to fend off the dragons, hence the name Dragon Force Elixir. Use to temporarily increase ATK by a large amount.
item_desc6051151.ch:
记录着龙力丹的炼制方法。
龙力丹：从前有一位修真者在服用了此丹药后，竟能以人类之躯硬撼龙族，此药因此得名。使用后能暂时提升较多的攻击。

item_desc6051171.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Bone Reconstruction Elixir.
Bone Reconstruction Elixir: The most common Elixir that strengthens bones. Use to temporarily increase DEF by a small amount.
item_desc6051171.ch:
记录着塑骨丹的炼制方法。
塑骨丹：能够提升自身基础骨骼强度，降低在战斗中陨落的风险，是八荒中最为常见的炼体丹。使用后能暂时提升少量的防御。

item_desc6051181.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Solid Jade Elixir.
Solid Jade Elixir: All sects use this Elixir on their disciples with high potential. It's said to be able to make bones harder than steel. Use to temporarily increase DEF by a medium amount.
item_desc6051181.ch:
记录着玉琼丹的炼制方法。
玉琼丹：宗门在培养核心弟子时不可缺少的一种丹药，高品质的丹药甚至能够将修真者的骨骼提升到比钢铁还坚固的地步。使用后能暂时提升一定的防御。

item_desc6051191.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Meridian Elixir.
Meridian Elixir: Though its concoction process is complicated and difficult, this Elixir makes bodies almost indestructible. Use to temporarily increase DEF by a medium amount.
item_desc6051191.ch:
记录着子午丹的炼制方法。
子午丹：炼制手段复杂、需要的药材繁琐的丹药，但若能够服用此丹药，据说肉体能够提升到刀枪不入的境界。使用后能暂时提升一定的防御。

item_desc6051201.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Golden Bone Elixir.
Golden Bone Elixir: Legend has it, Cultivators who took this Elixir will have their bones turned into gold. Their bodies would remain intact even after they've been dead for many years. Use to temporarily increase DEF by a large amount.
item_desc6051201.ch:
记录着蜕骨丹的炼制方法。
蜕骨丹：据说服用了此丹药的修真者，全身骨骼会蜕变为金骨，即便陨落多年也能够保持肉身不灭。使用后能暂时提升较多的防御。

item_desc6051211.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Celestial Elixir.
Celestial Elixir: This Elixir greatly strengthens the bodies of those who take it, but its complicated concoction progress and hard-to-get materials make it so that it existd almost solely in legend. Use to temporarily increase DEF by a large amount.
item_desc6051211.ch:
记录着浑天丹的炼制方法。
浑天丹：磅礴的药力会将服用此丹药者的躯体强度大幅度提升，但炼制所需的炼丹技艺以及炼制材料都太过于苛刻，这种丹药已经成了一个传说。使用后能暂时提升较多的防御。

item_desc6051221.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Martial Body Elixir.
Martial Body Elixir: A must-have Elixir if you want to strengthen your body to the extreme. Use to temporarily increase DEF by an enormous amount.
item_desc6051221.ch:
记录着真武塑体丹的炼制方法。
真武塑体丹：肉身强度想要登峰造极必不可少的丹药之一。使用后能暂时提升大量的防御。

item_desc6051231.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Longevity Elixir.
Longevity Elixir: More precious than ordinary Elixirs, this Elixir makes people live longer. Use to increase Lifespan by a small amount.
item_desc6051231.ch:
记录着延寿丹的炼制方法。
延寿丹：能够延年益寿的基本丹药，跟寻常丹药相比起来显得尤其珍贵。使用后增加少量的寿命上限。

item_desc6051241.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Endurance Elixir.
Endurance Elixir: A luxurious Elixir only for those in power. Use to increase Lifespan by a medium amount.
item_desc6051241.ch:
记录着壮元丹的炼制方法。
壮元丹：大多是供奉给有权势之人的丹药，在寻常的修真者眼中极其珍贵。使用后增加一定的寿命上限。

item_desc6051251.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Ether Elixir.
Ether Elixir: An effective Elixir that makes people live longer. It's hard to get even if you have the money. Use to increase Lifespan by a medium amount.
item_desc6051251.ch:
记录着补天丹的炼制方法。
补天丹：效果非常好的延寿药品，往往有价无市，一颗难求。使用后增加一定的寿命上限。

item_desc6051261.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Fuling Elixir.
Fuling Elixir: Anyone who takes this Elixir will live more than 200 years. Use to increase Lifespan by a large amount.
item_desc6051261.ch:
记录着茯苓丹的炼制方法。
茯苓丹：即便是普通人，在服用此丹之后都可轻松活过二百余年。使用后增加大量的寿命上限。

item_desc6051271.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Earth Deity Elixir.
Earth Deity Elixir: Only available in the sects with the best Alchemists, this Elixir is for sect leaders and core members. Use to increase Lifespan by a large amount.
item_desc6051271.ch:
记录着地仙丹的炼制方法。
地仙丹：只有顶尖炼丹师的强大宗门，才能够产出的丹药。一般供奉给宗主及宗门内的核心人员。使用后增加大量的寿命上限。

item_desc6051281.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Empyrean Longevity Elixir.
Empyrean Longevity Elixir: A respectable elder has been protecting his sect since it was founded a long, long time ago. He's able to do that because he took this Elixir. Use to increase Lifespan by an enormous amount.
item_desc6051281.ch:
记录着九天禳寿丹的炼制方法。
九天镶寿丹：听闻某顶尖宗门的太上长老从上古时期一直庇护着宗门至今，而他正是服用了这种丹药。使用后增加大量的寿命上限。

item_desc6051291.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Yellow Essence Pill.
Yellow Essence Pill: An ordinary Elixir that increases Health by a certain amount.
item_desc6051291.ch:
记录着黄精丸的炼制方法。
黄精丸：八荒中十分常见的药物，能够帮助修真者恢复身体机能。使用后恢复一定的健康。

item_desc6051301.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Shiquan Dabu Pill.
Shiquan Dabu Pill: A precious Elixir that quickly increases Health by a certain percentage.
item_desc6051301.ch:
记录着十全大补丸的炼制方法。
十全大补丸：价值较高的药物，其强大的药效能够迅速帮助修真者恢复身体。使用后恢复一定比例的健康。

item_desc6051311.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Deca Essence Pill.
Deca Essence Pill: A must-have Elixir for Cultivators during their cultivation journeys. Use it in crucial moments to recover Stamina by a certain amount.
item_desc6051311.ch:
记录着十精丸的炼制方法。
十精丸：修真者外出修炼必带的药物之一，能够在关键时刻恢复精力以应对各种突发情况。使用后恢复一定的精力。

item_desc6051321.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Ginseng Pill.
Ginseng Pill: An effective Elixir that quickly increases Stamina by a certain percentage.
item_desc6051321.ch:
记录着人参养荣丸的炼制方法。
人参养荣丸：药效强大的药品，能够帮助修真者在最短时间内迅速恢复自身部分精力。使用后恢复一定比例的精力。

item_desc6051331.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Cosmetic Elixir.
Cosmetic Elixir: This anti-aging Elixir is popular amongst female Cultivators. Use to increase Charisma by a small amount.
item_desc6051331.ch:
记录着养颜丹的炼制方法。
养颜丹：最受各路女修真者们喜欢的丹药，能够让自己的容颜永葆青春。使用后增加少量的魅力值。

item_desc6051341.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Glamor Elixir.
Glamor Elixir: This Elixir can't make people any stronger, but it's always sold at a high price. Use to increase Charisma by a medium amount.
item_desc6051341.ch:
记录着复容丹的炼制方法。
复容丹：哪怕不具备任何强身健体的功能，总是能够在坊市中以非常高的价格拍卖掉。使用后增加一定的魅力值。

item_desc6051351.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Lasting Beauty Elixir.
Lasting Beauty Elixir: The dream Elixir of all Cultivators who care about their appearance. Use to increase Charisma by a large amount.
item_desc6051351.ch:
记录着琉璃驻颜丹的炼制方法。
琉璃驻颜丹：所有爱美的修真者们都梦寐以求的丹药。使用后增加大量的魅力值。

item_desc6051361.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Sun Power Elixir.
Sun Power Elixir: This Elixir quickly enhances physique. Use to increase Max Vitality by a small amount.
item_desc6051361.ch:
记录着开阳丹的炼制方法。
开阳丹：只需要服用一颗，便可以肉眼可见的速度提升自身体魄。使用后增加少量的体力上限。

item_desc6051371.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Physique Elixir.
Physique Elixir: A must-have Elixir if you want to enhance your physique to the extreme. Use to increase Max Vitality by a medium amount.
item_desc6051371.ch:
记录着炼体丹的炼制方法。
炼体丹：想要将自身体魄修炼到极限不可缺少的丹药。使用后增加一定的体力上限。

item_desc6051381.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Spirit Melting Elixir.
Spirit Melting Elixir: An Elixir that enhances Energy. It's rare and difficult to concoct, so it's quite expensive. Use to increase Max Energy by a small amount.
item_desc6051381.ch:
记录着融灵丹的炼制方法。
融灵丹：能够提升自身灵力强度的丹药，但过于稀少以及炼制困难，导致价格比较昂贵。使用后增加少量的灵力上限。

item_desc6051391.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Energy Fortifying Elixir.
Energy Fortifying Elixir: A must-have Elixir if you want to enhance your energy level to the extreme. Use to increase Max Energy by a medium amount.
item_desc6051391.ch:
记录着炼神丹的炼制方法。
炼神丹：想要将自身灵力修炼到极限不可缺少的丹药。使用后增加一定的灵力上限。

item_desc6051401.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Soul Basis Elixir.
Soul Basis Elixir: An Elixir that enhances concentration level. Use to increase Max Focus by a small amount.
item_desc6051401.ch:
记录着蕴魂丹的炼制方法。
蕴魂丹：十分珍贵的丹药，能够提升使用者的灵魂强度。使用后增加少量的念力上限。

item_desc6051411.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Soul Refining Elixir.
Soul Refining Elixir: A must-have Elixir if you want to enhance your concentration level to the extreme. Use to increase Max Focus by a medium amount.
item_desc6051411.ch:
记录着炼魂丹的炼制方法。
炼魂丹：想要将自身魂魄修炼到极限不可缺少的丹药。使用后增加一定的念力上限。

item_desc6051421.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Foundation Elixir (Mortal).
Foundation Elixir (Mortal): An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Qi Refining and reach Foundation - Mortal. It increases the Breakthrough's success rate.
item_desc6051421.ch:
记录着筑基丹的炼制方法。
筑基丹：能够帮助炼气界的修真者突破至人道筑基的丹药，是大部分炼气界修真者的目标。增加突破至人道筑基的成功概率。

item_desc6051431.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Qi Condensation Elixir.
Qi Condensation Elixir: The dream Elixir of all Cultivators of the Foundation Realm. The higher its rarity, the greater help it'll provide. It increases the success rate of breaking through to Qi Condensation.
item_desc6051431.ch:
记录着化晶丹的炼制方法。
化晶丹：所有筑基境修真者所追求的丹药，品质越高，在突破时能够给予修真者的帮助就越大。增加突破至结晶境的成功概率。

item_desc6051441.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Foundation Elixir (Heaven).
Foundation Elixir (Heaven): The dream Elixir of many Cultivators of the Qi Refining Realm. It increases the success rate of breaking through to Foundation - Heaven.
item_desc6051441.ch:
记录着天乾丹的炼制方法。
天乾丹：许多炼气界修真者梦寐以求的丹药，只有少数修真强者能够提供给自己的后辈。增加突破至天道筑基的成功概率。

item_desc6051451.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Foundation Elixir (Earth).
Foundation Elixir (Earth): The high price of this Elixir scares away many Rogue Cultivators. It increases the success rate of breaking through to Foundation - Earth.
item_desc6051451.ch:
记录着地坤丹的炼制方法。
地坤丹：高昂的价值让许多散修都望而却步，只有宗门与家族才有条件提供给弟子们一定的数量。增加突破至地道筑基的成功概率。

item_desc6051461.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Thousand River Elixir.
Thousand River Elixir: An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Qi Condensation and reach G1 Golden Core. It increases the Breakthrough's success rate.
item_desc6051461.ch:
记录着万河丹的炼制方法。
万河丹：能够帮助结晶境修真者突破至一品金丹的丹药，只有顶尖的大宗门才会有少量的丹药提供给门下的精英弟子。增加突破至一品金丹成功概率。

item_desc6051471.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Soul Gathering Elixir.
Soul Gathering Elixir: An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Qi Condensation and reach G2 Golden Core. It increases the Breakthrough's success rate.

聚灵丹：能够帮助结晶境修真者突破至二品金丹的丹药，其炼制所需的药材是修真者们的必争之物。增加突破至二品金丹的成功概率。

item_desc6051481.en:

item_desc6051491.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Cloud Elixir.
Cloud Elixir: An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Qi Condensation and reach G4 Golden Core. It increases the Breakthrough's success rate.

云中丹：能够帮助结晶境修真者突破至四品金丹的丹药，其昂贵的价值让多数修真者望而却步。增加突破至四品金丹的成功概率。

item_desc6051501.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Three Flower Elixir.
Three Flower Elixir: An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Qi Condensation and reach G5 Golden Core. It increases the Breakthrough's success rate.

三花丹：能够帮助结晶境修真者突破至五品金丹的丹药，是大部分结晶境修真者的目标。增加突破至五品金丹的成功概率。

item_desc6051511.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Spirit Transformation Elixir.
Spirit Transformation Elixir: An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Golden Core and reach Origin Spirit. It increases the Breakthrough's success rate.
item_desc6051511.ch:
记录着化灵丹的炼制方法。
化灵丹：能够帮助金丹境界修真者突破至具灵的丹药，是所有金丹修真者的必争之物。增加突破至具灵境的成功概率。

item_desc6051521.en:
记录着六窍丹的炼制方法。
六窍丹：能够帮助金丹境修真者突破至天道元婴的丹药，有顶尖的大宗门才会有少量的丹药提供给门下的精英弟子。增加突破至天道元婴的成功概率。
item_desc6051521.ch:
记录着六窍丹的炼制方法。
六窍丹：能够帮助金丹境修真者突破至天道元婴的丹药，有顶尖的大宗门才会有少量的丹药提供给门下的精英弟子。增加突破至天道元婴的成功概率。

item_desc6051531.en:
记录着破茧丹的炼制方法。
破茧丹：能够帮助金丹境修真者突破至地道元婴的丹药，只有少数强大的宗门和家族能够提供给门下弟子。增加突破至地道元婴的成功概率。
item_desc6051531.ch:
记录着破茧丹的炼制方法。
破茧丹：能够帮助金丹境修真者突破至地道元婴的丹药，只有少数强大的宗门和家族能够提供给门下弟子。增加突破至地道元婴的成功概率。

item_desc6051541.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Nascent Soul Elixir (Mortal).
Nascent Soul Elixir (Mortal): An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Origin Spirit and reach Nascent Soul - Mortal. It increases the Breakthrough's success rate.
item_desc6051541.ch:
记录着结婴丹的炼制方法。
结婴丹：能够帮助具灵境修真者突破至人道元婴的丹药，是大部分具灵境修真者的目标。增加突破至人道元婴的成功概率。

item_desc6051551.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Soul Reconstruction Elixir.
Soul Reconstruction Elixir: An Elixir that reconstructs the Divine Soul of <g>Sealed - Gouchen</g>. Afterwards, you can enter its trial. Pass the trial to receive <g>Gouchen's Divine Soul</g>. If a sect has abundant <g>Herbs</g>, it may concoct the Soul Reconstruction Elixir and sell it in the <g>Treasure Pavilion</g>.
item_desc6051551.ch:
记录着化神丹的炼制方法。
化神丹：能够帮助<g>镇灵勾陈</g>重塑神魂的丹药，重塑其神魂后可进入勾陈的试炼，通过试炼后即可获得<g>勾陈神魂</g>。若宗门的<g>药材资源</g>丰富，<g>聚宝仙楼</g>中可能会出现由宗门炼制的化神丹。

item_desc6051561.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Enlightenment Elixir.
Enlightenment Elixir: An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Soul Formation and reach Enlightenment. If a sect has abundant <g>Herbs</g>, it may concoct the Enlightenment Elixir and sell it in the <g>Treasure Pavilion</g>.
item_desc6051561.ch:
记录着悟道丹的炼制方法。
悟道丹：能够帮助化神境修真者突破至悟道境的丹药，是大部分化神境修真者所追求的目标。若宗门的<g>药材资源</g>丰富，<g>聚宝仙楼</g>中可能会出现由宗门炼制的悟道丹。

item_desc6051571.en:
记录着天化丹的炼制方法。
天化丹：能够帮助化神境修真者突破至天道悟道境、地道悟道境、玄道悟道境的丹药，即便是在一些顶尖宗门内也极其稀有，非常难以获得。
item_desc6051571.ch:
记录着天化丹的炼制方法。

item_desc6051581.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Reborn Elixir.
Reborn Elixir: An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Enlightenment and reach Reborn.
item_desc6051581.ch:
记录着羽化丹的炼制方法。
羽化丹：能够帮助悟道境修真者突破至羽化境的丹药，是所有悟道境修真者的目标。

item_desc6051591.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Transcendent Elixir (Yellow).
Transcendent Elixir (Yellow): An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through to Transcendent - Yellow. It increases the Breakthrough's success rate.
item_desc6051591.ch:
记录着登仙丹的炼制方法。
登仙丹：所有修真者都梦寐以求的丹药，能在修真者突破至登仙境时提供一定的帮助。炼制所需的天材地宝都极其罕见。增加突破至登仙境成功概率。

item_desc6051601.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Three Path Transcendent Elixir.
Three Path Transcendent Elixir: The dream Elixir of all Cultivators, it helps with the Breakthrough to Transcendent - Heaven, Transcendent - Earth, and Transcendent - Dark by increasing the success rate.
item_desc6051601.ch:
记录着鸿蒙丹的炼制方法。
鸿蒙丹：所有修真者都梦寐以求的丹药，能在修真者突破至登仙境时提供一定的帮助。炼制所需的天材地宝都极其罕见。增加突破至登仙境成功概率。

item_desc6051611.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Majestic Dragon Elixir.
Majestic Dragon Elixir: This Elixir removes Disturbed Qi from Cultivators who failed to break through.
item_desc6051611.ch:
记录着黄龙丹的炼制方法。
黄龙丹：能够帮助突破失败的修真者稳固气息。治疗气息紊乱。

item_desc6051621.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Ice Heart Elixir.
Ice Heart Elixir: This Elixir removes Unstable Realm from Cultivators who failed to break through.
item_desc6051621.ch:
记录着冰心丹的炼制方法。
冰心丹：能够帮助突破失败的修真者稳固境界。治疗境界不稳。

item_desc6051631.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Azure Dragon Elixir.
Azure Dragon Elixir: This Elixir removes Blocked Meridians from Cultivators who failed to break through.
item_desc6051631.ch:
记录着青龙丹的炼制方法。
青龙丹：能够帮助突破失败的修真者重新打通筋脉。治疗筋脉受阻。

item_desc6051641.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Starry Elixir.
Starry Elixir: This Elixir removes Distraught from Cultivators who failed to break through.
item_desc6051641.ch:
记录着星罗丹的炼制方法。
星罗丹：能够帮助突破失败的玩家稳固心神。治疗心神错乱。

item_desc6051651.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Signless Elixir.
Signless Elixir: This Elixir removes Hindrance from Cultivators who failed to break through.
item_desc6051651.ch:
记录着无相丹的炼制方法。
无相丹：能够帮助突破失败的玩家稳固道根。治疗道根受阻。

item_desc6051661.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Bone Repair Elixir.
Bone Repair Elixir: An ordinary Elixir that grants a quick recovery for injured Cultivators. Use to remove Heavily Wounded.
item_desc6051661.ch:
记录着生骨丹的炼制方法。
生骨丹：常见的疗伤丹药，服用能使深受重伤的修真者迅速修复骨骼与血肉。使用后治疗重伤效果。

item_desc6051671.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Curing Elixir.
Curing Elixir: A powerful Elixir that removes Internal Injury.
item_desc6051671.ch:
记录着大还丹的炼制方法。
大还丹：强大的药效能够在短时间内治愈所受到的内伤。使用后治疗内伤效果。

item_desc6051681.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Body Reconstruction Elixir I.
Body Reconstruction Elixir I: A precious Elixir that helps Cultivators of the Golden Core Realm reconstruct their body.
item_desc6051681.ch:
记录着三阳生骨丹的炼制方法。
三阳生骨丹：非常珍贵的丹药，能够帮助修真者稳固自身魂魄。使用后可帮助金丹境的修真者重塑肉身。

A set of instructions for concocting the Body Reconstruction Elixir IV.
Body Reconstruction Elixir IV: A precious Elixir that helps Cultivators of the Reborn Realm or the Transcendent Realm reconstruct their body.
item_desc6051684.ch:
记录着九转还魂丹的炼制方法。
九转还魂丹：非常珍贵的丹药，能够帮助修真者稳固自身魂魄。使用后可帮助羽化境及登仙境的修真者重塑肉身。

item_desc6051691.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Detox Elixir.
Detox Elixir: A must-have Elixir for tomb raiders. Use to remove Corpse Poison and Nether Poison.
item_desc6051691.ch:
记录着清蕴丹的炼制方法。
清蕴丹：倒斗必备的丹药，具有强大的解毒功效。使用后治疗尸毒与阴毒效果。

item_desc6051701.en:
A set of instructions for concocting the Floral Healing Elixir.
Floral Healing Elixir: This Elixir is hard to come by because of its complicated concoction process and materials. Use to remove Heavily Wounded and Internal Injury and immunize against them for some time.
item_desc6051701.ch:
记录着三花护心丹的炼制方法。
三花护心丹：无论是炼制手法亦是炼制材料都让此丹几乎绝迹，效率自然也是无与伦比的。使用后治疗重伤与内伤并免疫一段时间。

item_desc6051711.en:
set of instructions for concocting the Taixuan Elixir.
Taixuan Elixir: A legendary antidote effective against all poisons. Use to remove all poison effects and immunize against them for some time.
item_desc6051711.ch:
记录着太玄复明丹的炼制方法。
太玄复明丹：传说中的解毒圣药，据说无论中了多严重的毒，服用后都能化解。使用后治疗所有毒素并免疫一段时间。

item_desc6061061.en:
A Furnace used for concocting Elixirs. Required Alchemy stat: 20. This Furnace has 3 material slots.
[Rehabilitation]: Every time you add a material, you have a 20% chance to increase all elements by 100.
[Sacred Jade]: Chance of the Furnace exploding -5%
item_desc6061061.ch:

item_desc6061071.en:
A Furnace used for concocting Elixirs. Required Alchemy stat: 40. This Furnace has 3 material slots.
[Bolster] (Active skill. You must click to use it.): Consume 3 Durability to double the highest element. This skill can only be used 1 time per concoction.

item_desc6061071.ch:

【仙玉】炸炉的概率降低5%。

item_desc6061081.en:

【增灵】每次放入材料时，将使一个随机的元素增加100点。
